resources.string: Local monitoring needs no account or subscription. Models download once, after confirmation. Recognition and images stay on this phone. Optional paired alerts send encrypted text through a relay you choose. Keep the monitoring phone fixed, powered and the app visible; leaving or locking stops its camera. No cloud AI or paid service is included. This preview is not a safety alarm.
Pair with another phone to receive its alerts.
Public relays may have limits or outages. Delivery is not guaranteed; pictures are never sent.
On the other phone, scan this group’s QR code or paste its pairing code.
Keep receiving enabled and allow this app to run without battery restrictions. Sleep, force-stop and network loss can delay alerts. Start receiving again after a restart.
